## Body

At #334 head 8f705b4ee8308018e235f2c64ed77912e3bc8133, B334-R1-01 showed that the drain read its latest receiver edge before the two pane captures 250 ms apart, then reused that snapshot through submission. A real-store/fake-tmux regression queued a parent restart, waited for capture_without_launch to record the first pane read, published native.receiver.renewed during the settle, and observed one /restart where zero was required. A restart admitted after renewal still typed correctly. This differs from F274 decision-time admission: audit the actual typing boundary, not just whether recovery was queued safely. Keep a capture-barrier renewal regression and the after-renewal positive control; name the linearization point rather than claiming protection across all later awaits. A per-daemon duplicate map does not cover a human restart or a recreated drain. The governed verdict 7b146790d3f9000e496c766dbdeb9c82bfdb680e includes the minimal regression; three guard mutants were killed against existing tests. Under amended C34 the prime checks fix commits, with no second reviewer round.
